EMS reason: HIGH price, PV unavailable and battery has energy -> battery supplies load.
HIGH price and PV available -> PV supplies load.
HIGH price, PV unavailable and battery has energy -> battery supplies load.
HIGH price, but load demand is too high for PEM (60.4 mW >= 40.0 mW) -> grid supplies load.
HIGH price, PV unavailable, battery low, PEM has usable hydrogen and load demand is below 40 mW -> PEM supplies load.
